parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe how the piezoelectric crystal in a transducer generates ultrasound waves for use in medical diagnosis.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
A parallel ultrasound beam is incident on the boundary between two media, as illustrated in Fig. 10.1.

{{figure:figure_10_1.png}}

The media have specific acoustic impedances $Z_1$ and $Z_2$.

At the boundary, a fraction $\alpha$ of the incident intensity of the ultrasound beam is reflected. The remainder is transmitted.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: State what is meant by specific acoustic impedance.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Describe how $\alpha$ depends on the relative values of $Z_1$ and $Z_2$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
A parallel ultrasound beam of intensity $I_0$ enters a region of soft tissue. After passing a distance of $2.1\text{ cm}$ through this tissue, the intensity of the ultrasound is $0.62I_0$.

Calculate the linear attenuation coefficient $\mu$ of ultrasound in the soft tissue. Give a unit with your answer.
